none: PAS FindID 972294: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Valentinian (364-378), Victory left, Reece period 19, probably Arles mint. Both sides are pitted. Obverse description: Bust rosette diademed probably cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]VAL[--]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm. Possibly [?]U in right field. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. In exergue: probably CO[N]. Diameter: 17.1mm, Weight: 1.74gms, die axis: 6
